action_record.description: Each serialized action record carries exactly three fields: the action id, its params, and the resulting state hash.

action_id.description: String of the form <action_name>:<item_index>, e.g. connect:3.

params.description: The params object exactly as executed.

state_hash.description: 64 hex chars: SHA-256 over the canonical canvas serialization taken immediately after the action completed.

canvas.node_transform: The canvas nodes map is converted to the array by iterating map keys sorted numerically by node id (n1 < n2 < n10) and emitting one element per node with keys in the order id, label, type, x, y (byte-ascending).

definition.json_rules: UTF-8 bytes of JSON with object keys sorted ascending (byte order), arrays in the defined sort order, no whitespace outside string values, no trailing newline.
definition.number_formatting: Guide coordinates are rounded to the nearest integer (round half up) before hashing; floats never appear in the canonical form. All other numbers serialize as plain JSON numbers.

canonical_serialization.state_hash: SHA-256, hex-encoded, over the canonical serialization bytes of {nodes, edges, annotations} taken immediately after the action completes.

description: Versioned schema for executor state snapshots. snapshot_version is frozen at 1.0.0 for Phase 0.

actions.description: The last N action records, oldest first. N = 32.

annotations.description: Session-layer annotations (retention ranges, confirmations, review flags), sorted by (node_id numeric, kind), ties broken by canonical payload JSON byte order (UTF-8).

additionalProperties.description: The recorded result of the action, returned verbatim on replay.

applied_keys.description: Idempotency keys mapped to their recorded results. Replaying a key returns the recorded result and performs no work. Keys are never deleted except by moving to the tombstone set on undo.

dropped_prefix.description: Verifiability of what was truncated away.

count.description: Number of action records dropped from the front of the window.

prefix_hash.description: Iterative hash chain per window.truncation_rule. An empty prefix (count 0) is H(0), the SHA-256 hex of the empty string.

item_index.description: Index of the next recipe item to execute.

snapshot_version.description: Snapshot format version. Frozen at exactly 1.0.0 for Phase 0. The const (no patch flexibility), unlike the recipe schema_version pattern, is deliberate: the executor writes exactly the format it implements, and readers reject anything else loudly.

terminated.description: True once abort_session has sealed the snapshot; no further items execute.

abort_reason.description: The abort reason when terminated is true, else null.

title: AI-data-map state snapshot schema

window.justification: 32 covers a full small-org recipe (typically 8-20 items) plus one full pass of recovery actions (undo/skip/retry) with headroom, while keeping the serialized snapshot under ~64 KB so it fits comfortably in the model's context on every step.
window.truncation_rule: The actions array keeps the most recent 32 records. When a 33rd record arrives, the oldest is moved into dropped_prefix: count increments by one and the prefix hash advances as an iterative chain. Let H(0) be the SHA-256 hex digest of the empty string. When dropping a record whose state_hash is the 64-char lowercase hex string h, H(k+1) = SHA-256 hex digest of the UTF-8 bytes of the ASCII string (H(k) concatenated with h). Byte encoding is fixed: ASCII bytes of the lowercase hex digests, never raw bytes. Worked example: H(0)=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855. Drop a record with state_hash=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa: H(1)=52eb1e93d4e47646bf787c48513698fcde9f5952763a7a4bfa7c52fe0e8388e8. Drop a second record with state_hash=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb: H(2)=aa15cd3f0802376650ebc56322cdec1bf6f6990ed2602dd0648bbd8b10646195.
